name: Mexico City by Night: Packs, Covens, and Locations (Lore)

pages.name: La Cruz de Machetes (The Machete Cross)

text.content: Born when 1980s liberation theology met the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, this pack began with Father Corbacho, a Guatemalan village priest Embraced for his political radicalism. After making a 1989 pilgrimage to the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe and never leaving, the pack fell under the abyss mystic Zadkiel's influence and, after Corbacho's destruction, passed leadership to his mad childe Father Yoel Rosen. The Machete Cross combines genuine piety with crude vigilante violence, murdering wealthy "oppressors" and exploiters and giving the proceeds to the poor or religious charities, sleeping in the crypt of a church partly collapsed in the 1985 earthquake in the Gustavo A. Madero delegation.

pages.name: Las Hermanitas de Zila (Little Sisters of Zillah)

text.content: A small, historically fragile pack of Noddist "undead nuns" who see themselves as humble servants of Caine, the Hermanitas hand-copy the Book of Nod, paint icons of Caine and the martyred Second Generation, and train missionaries who spread Noddist faith to the ignorant @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and independent clans (usually at the cost of the missionary's unlife). Nearly destroyed several times by internal strife and missionary losses — reduced to a single survivor in 1964 — the pack has gained new prestige since the priest Josefa's apocalyptic 1999 transformation and Monomacy victory over her predecessor. They maintain amicable relations with El Calpulli Rojo and keep their haven in a rotting Iztapalapa house.

Named for the six Mexican military cadets who leaped to their deaths rather than surrender to American invaders, this small coven trains potential Black Hand cadets under the diminutive @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} antitribu Teresita, who serves as its pack priest, ductus, and commanding officer. Few members stay more than five years before graduating into the Black Hand or meeting Final Death. Their sealed-off cellar haven (access via storm drains) is scrupulously clean and divided into sleeping, training, and ritae chambers, with Teresita's own boudoir styled as an incongruously delicate four-poster bedroom.

Named as a satirical play on Mexico's longest-ruling political party, the PDI operates from a condemned south-central Mexico City courthouse under the joint leadership of ductus General Perfidio Díos (bishop and political-subversion theorist) and pack priest Caridad de Flores. The coven sends intelligence-gathering packs into @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}-held cities annually, trading the results to the Black Hand for boons, and argues that the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} should engage far more directly with mortal business and government than the sect traditionally allows.

Founded by Captain Isidro de Saldanha and formally recognized as a Founded Pack by Regent Galbraith, Las Emblemas is the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s Masquerade cleanup crew — erasing witnesses' memories, destroying evidence, Dominating officials, and framing mortal scapegoats after Sabbat atrocities. Regent Galbraith's decree bound all Sabbat to cooperate with them under the Code of Milan's mutual-protection stricture, though many Loyalist Sabbat consider the coven's very existence — cleaning up after Cainite carelessness — a betrayal of the sect's ideals. Members bear a ritual forearm brand using the same process as the Black Hand's mark, though it commands far less respect.

A small, loose-knit coven of abyss mystics and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.n1ghtP4thOfN1ght]{Path of Night} students led by Zadkiel ben Aron, the Schichiriel take their name from the sole survivor lineage of a Brazilian @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} antitribu bloodline destroyed in 1803. Their subterranean storm-drain haven is a brick vault ringed with pipes around a hundred-foot well where Zadkiel sleeps, guarded by five permanently bound abyssal Retainer entities that attack anyone but him who descends more than 20 feet into the well's unnaturally cold black water.

A loose scientific association centered on Dr. Vermudo de Sancha's laboratory-haven in an abandoned Azcapotzalco factory, the University of Night brings together Cainites (chiefly de Sancha and his sire Efraín Sortano) interested in research, deliberately named as a challenge to the vanished @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu's own "University." The group holds mild contempt for sorcerers generally, and de Sancha's factory floor doubles as an operating theater stocked with kidnapped victims serving as both lab subjects and herd.

pages.name: El Grito de Dolor (The Cry of Pain)

text.content: Bishop Natalio's coven, named after the 1810 Grito de Dolores independence call, blends @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} philosophy with Mexican revolutionary nationalism. One of the city's largest packs, it includes a core of six trusted lieutenants and roughly a dozen others still being tested, along with looser "visiting priest" ties to the vatos and chicas of the shantytowns who follow Natalio's lead. Members regularly participate in the Vaulderie and serve as the connective tissue of Natalio's dozen-pack shantytown recruitment network.

pages.name: Los Hechiceros del Teocalli (The Sorcerers of the Teocalli)

text.content: Named for the old Aztec ritual district around the modern Zócalo, this loose occultist association coalesced around the koldun Esteban del Agua y Tierra and the Harbinger of Skulls La Viuda Blanca after they seized the secrets of the vanished @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu chantry. Their associates include numerous Noddists as well as the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} Bishop Rodolfo and his student Eliza Villanova, all drawn together by shared fascination with arcane lore and the approaching Final Nights.

Founded by the moderate @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} antitribu Frances Derossi during 18th-century @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} infighting between Spanish gachupín and creole Cainites, El Calpulli Rojo offers a communal, violence-free haven (under oath) for Sabbat uncomfortable with the sect's brutal tendencies. Declared a Founded Pack by Regent Galbraith and supported by Bishop Natalio, the compound is now led by ductus Joseph O'Grady and conducts auctoritas ritae like the Vaulderie and Sermons of Caine while offering full cooperation to the Sabbat Inquisition to preempt any heresy accusations against its "spineless" reputation.

Formed in the early 1990s when the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} pack Los Muertos Alegres Embraced two Tijuana Cartel gangsters, Carlos Diáz and Miguel Orozco, the Encapuchados spent three years as cartel enforcers before Sabbat bishops sanctioned their overt mortal-business dealings. Now pursuing a subtler strategy of Vaulderie-bound Embraces among cartel members rather than open warfare, Diáz and Orozco hope to seize territory from the collapsing Gulf Cartel to build Sabbat-aligned narcotics infrastructure — a gambit that risks provoking the cartels' notice if it grows much further.

An escaped @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu experiment in self-replicating @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.hs33xrNXWT2UXXS4]{Blood Brothers}, the first Hungry Sister was freed by accident when Esteban del Agua y Tierra and La Viuda Blanca broke into Elena Vasquez's abandoned chantry in 2000. Each successful "artificial Embrace" (roughly one in 10 attempts) transforms the childe into a physical duplicate of the sire, erasing memory and identity into a hive mind, and leaves both sire and childe famished enough to drain a dozen mortals in a single feeding. Now numbering around 20, the Sisters have carved a petty domain of fear from a disused hacienda basement in the eastern shantytowns, are unknowingly under Esteban's covert observation (he hopes to learn their reproduction secret), and are being marked for purge by Bishop Natalio as a threat to his own herds.

pages.name: The Zócalo and the Centro Histórico

text.content: Mexico City's ancient religious and political heart, built atop Tenochtitlán's teocalli, remains the haunt of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} who care about mortal government and business: Las Emblemas operates from a vecindad here spending much of its time infiltrating government, police, and media offices, while a former @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu chantry (now home to Esteban del Agua y Tierra and La Viuda Blanca) lies hidden beneath another. The elder ambassador Eleiser de Polanco walks the historic district's darkened palaces nightly, imagining sleeping aristocrats instead of empty government offices and museums.

A domain claimed outright by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} priscus Efraín Sortano ("the Zookeeper"), any Cainite who wishes to hunt or feed at the zoo must first join Sortano in a Vaulderie. Followers of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.aSh4ybe4GTvTn7LR]{Path of the Feral Heart} visit to observe the zoo's big cats and sometimes test themselves against them, and the park's grounds and animal population — many former humans, reshaped by Sortano's experiments — form the living heart of his Metamorphosist research.

pages.name: Villa de Guadalupe and the Basilica

text.content: The annual festival at the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe creates an uncomfortable concentration of mortal faith that most wise @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} avoid entirely, though a handful of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.n1ghtP4thOfN1ght]{Path of Night} devotees and other Cainites who preserve some twisted mortal-faith echo linger at its edges for the masochistic thrill. The resident Sabbat pack, the Machete Cross, made their unplanned home here after a 1989 pilgrimage to the Basilica from which they never departed.

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} revenant Pablo Salamanca y Grimaldi runs El Grupo Salamanca — the financial and legal-services empire that keeps the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s coffers, bribes, and mortal-world entanglements functioning — from high-rise offices in this landmark tower, quietly using his position to goad key Cainites into disastrous raids and duels as part of a decades-long secret campaign to free his enslaved revenant family from Sabbat blood bonds.

vtmlarp.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapters Two, Three, and Four
